authority: Department of Land Resources, Government of India / NIC
scope: Legacy MIS 3.0 national total only. Not the current MIS 4.0 State/UT table, not parcel title data, and not an owner-level dataset. The captured page did not show a reliable exact as-of date.

limitations: MIS 3.0 is retained only as a historical/legacy context layer.
